description: Flat record-level metadata schema for stool microbiota sequencing datasets from patients undergoing antibiotic treatment, capturing host context, specimen collection, medication/diet exposure, laboratory protocols, and sequencing/analysis provenance.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record/sample record.

participant_id.descr: Unique identifier linking samples from the same patient/participant; anonymized code preferred.

specimen_id.descr: Unique identifier for the stool specimen/sample.

collection_date.descr: Date the stool sample was collected (ISO 8601 date).

collection_timepoint_relative_to_antibio.descr: Timing of sample collection relative to antibiotic treatment (e.g., pre-treatment, day 3 of treatment, post-treatment week 2).

antibiotic_treatment_status.descr: Whether the participant was receiving antibiotics at the time of sample collection.

antibiotic_name.descr: Name of the antibiotic(s) administered at the time of sampling, if applicable.

antibiotic_class.descr: Pharmacological class of antibiotic(s), if known (e.g., beta-lactam, macrolide, fluoroquinolone).

antibiotic_dose_mg_per_day.descr: Total antibiotic dose in milligrams per day, if available.

antibiotic_route.descr: Route of antibiotic administration (e.g., oral, intravenous, topical).

antibiotic_start_date.descr: Date when the current antibiotic course began.

antibiotic_end_date.descr: Date when the current antibiotic course ended or is expected to end.

antibiotic_duration_days.descr: Duration of the antibiotic course in days.

other_medication_use.descr: Whether any other medications were being used around the time of sampling.

other_medications.descr: List of other medications used near the sampling time, if any (free text or controlled names).

probiotic_use.descr: Whether probiotic products were used near the time of sampling.

probiotic_details.descr: Probiotic product name/composition and timing of use, if applicable.

health_status.descr: Participant health status at sampling time (e.g., healthy, hospitalized, infection, inflammatory disease, gastrointestinal symptoms).

diagnosis_or_condition.descr: Primary clinical diagnosis or condition relevant to antibiotic use and gut microbiota status.

gastrointestinal_symptoms_present.descr: Whether gastrointestinal symptoms were present at sampling time.

gastrointestinal_symptoms_details.descr: Description of gastrointestinal symptoms, if present (e.g., diarrhea, abdominal pain, constipation).

age_years.descr: Participant age in years at the time of sampling.

sex.descr: Reported sex of the participant (e.g., female, male, intersex, unknown).

bmi_kg_m2.descr: Body mass index in kg/m^2, if available.

diet_pattern.descr: Usual or recent diet pattern relevant to microbiota interpretation (e.g., omnivorous, vegetarian, high-fiber, low-carbohydrate).

dietary_restrictions.descr: Specific dietary restrictions or notable exclusions relevant to microbiota composition.

recent_diet_change.descr: Whether there was a recent change in diet prior to sample collection.

recent_diet_change_details.descr: Description of the recent diet change and approximate timing, if applicable.

stool_consistency.descr: Stool consistency at collection, preferably using a standardized scale such as Bristol stool scale.

collection_method.descr: Method used to collect the stool sample (e.g., home kit, clinic collection, rectal swab if used as substitute).

collection_container.descr: Type of collection container or kit used.

collection_storage_temperature_c.descr: Storage temperature in degrees Celsius before processing or shipping.

time_to_freezing_hours.descr: Time from collection to freezing in hours.

time_to_extraction_hours.descr: Time from collection to nucleic acid extraction in hours.

sample_mass_mg.descr: Mass of stool input used for extraction in milligrams.

sample_volume_ml.descr: Volume of specimen input used, if measured in mL.

nucleic_acid_type.descr: Type of nucleic acid extracted (e.g., DNA, RNA, total nucleic acid).

extraction_kit.descr: Name and version of the nucleic acid extraction kit or protocol.

extraction_protocol_details.descr: Key extraction protocol details, including bead-beating, lysis conditions, and modifications.

nucleic_acid_yield_ng.descr: Total nucleic acid yield in nanograms.

nucleic_acid_concentration_ng_per_ul.descr: Concentration of extracted nucleic acid in ng/µL.

purity_a260_a280.descr: A260/A280 purity ratio of extracted nucleic acid.

library_prep_kit.descr: Name and version of the library preparation kit or protocol.

library_prep_method.descr: Library preparation approach (e.g., shotgun metagenomic, 16S rRNA amplicon, metatranscriptomic).

library_insert_size_bp.descr: Average insert size in base pairs, if applicable.

pcr_cycles.descr: Number of PCR amplification cycles used during library preparation, if applicable.

indexed_library_id.descr: Identifier of the prepared sequencing library.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used (e.g., Illumina NovaSeq, MiSeq, Oxford Nanopore).

sequencing_chemistry.descr: Sequencing chemistry or kit version used on the platform.

read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs for short-read sequencing or approximate read length for long-read runs.

sequencing_lane.descr: Lane or flow-cell lane identifier, if applicable.

multiplexed_sample_count.descr: Number of samples pooled in the sequencing run or lane.

raw_read_count.descr: Number of raw sequencing reads generated for this sample.

quality_filtering_applied.descr: Whether quality filtering/trimming was applied prior to downstream analysis.

quality_filtering_method.descr: Software or method used for quality filtering/trimming, if applied.

host_read_removal_applied.descr: Whether host-derived reads were removed before analysis.

host_reference_genome.descr: Reference genome used for host read removal, if applicable.

taxonomic_profiling_method.descr: Method/software used for microbial taxonomic profiling, if performed.

alpha_diversity_metric.descr: Alpha diversity metric reported for the sample, if applicable (e.g., Shannon, observed ASVs).

alpha_diversity_value.descr: Numeric value of the alpha diversity metric for the sample.

beta_diversity_grouping.descr: Grouping or comparison context used for beta diversity analysis, if applicable.

resistance_gene_database.descr: Database used for antimicrobial resistance gene identification (e.g., CARD, ResFinder, ARG-ANNOT).

resistance_gene_detection_method.descr: Software or approach used to identify resistance genes.

resistance_gene_count.descr: Number of resistance genes detected in the sample.

resistance_gene_abundance_normalization.descr: Normalization unit used for resistance gene abundance (e.g., copies per million reads, RPKM).

contamination_screened.descr: Whether contamination screening or negative-control assessment was performed.

negative_control_included.descr: Whether a negative control was included in the extraction/library/sequencing batch.

batch_effect_flag.descr: Indicator that the sample may be affected by a known batch effect or technical issue.

notes.descr: Free-text notes on unusual sample handling, protocol deviations, or interpretation-relevant details.
